note: How the game feeds its sound (src/audio/index.js, src/audio/game-state.js, src/world/sound-near.js; docs 17 and 25). updateHz: how often the sound state is built and the ambience updated (doc 17: 10 Hz). near: what is close to the camera target, sampled every nearEveryS seconds over a circle of radiusM (doc 17: within 12 m), cell by cell (the water summary's half-meter cells, the growth grid's one-meter cells), each cell weighted by closeness (1 at the center, falloff at the edge). Water kinds come from the water summary's classes: still is pond water, slow and running are streams. Ponds count by their share of the circle; streams are thin, so slow and running count by how close the nearest stream cell is: full within streamFullM, easing to none at radiusM. Cells beyond the summary are open sea; the sea counts toward nearWater for the rain on open water, but not toward the pond lap. fullAt is the share of weighted points that counts as fully near (so a pond filling a third of the circle already sounds like a pond). Pads and reeds count plants within plantReachM of each point, each species at its weight in pads and reeds (lilies make pads; reeds, and irises at half, make reeds); the rush cover counts as reeds at rushWeight. grass: the grass cover (0..255) that counts as full grass. gust: the wind's gusts, which the weather does not keep, made here on a seeded rhythm: a gust comes every everyS seconds (shorter as wind rises, divided by everyWindScale plus the wind), rises to a peak between peak[0] and peak[1] scaled up by the wind, lasts holdS, and the level follows its target at followPerS. frost (doc 25): winter mornings are frosty until the sun burns it off. frost = the winter weight, times a curve of hours from sunrise (byHourFromSunrise, flat past the ends), times 1 - cloudCut * cloud, and none while it rains. afterRainH: game hours of drips after rain stops (doc 25 asks for one to two). frogs: the frog agents decide who calls and when (src/world/creatures/agents.js, with the 0.4 s answering rule and the hush after a startle, doc 23); the sound reads their new calls and plops every pollS seconds and starts each leadS seconds ahead on the audio clock, as the throat starts to swell. A call or plop older than staleS (after a hidden tab, say) is let go rather than played late. A call's intensity goes from intensityFromMood[0] for an unsettled frog (mood 0) to [1] for a content one. plop: the bubble size (cm) and level range of a frog going into the water (doc 25 frog body sounds), placed where it went in. When a frog calls within duckNearM of the camera, the music dips by mixer.json duck.db and comes back duckHoldS after the last such call (doc 24, finding a frog by ear). music: the director decides updateHz times a second (doc 24: 2 Hz). nowPlaying (src/ui/now-playing.js): the piece's name is fully shown atShare of the way through it, fading in over fadeInS, resting holdS, fading out over fadeOutS (Calm motion makes the fades short). reveal (doc 17 and doc 25, The reveal): an absence of fullFromH game hours or more gets the full reveal. Its sound starts from silence: the island's own sounds (sea, air, wind, water lap) rise over ambienceInS seconds, the creatures fade in from creaturesAtS seconds over creaturesInS as the animals come back, and when the reveal ends everything returns to the settings over endInS. The music plays the home tide (recipes/music/director.json reveal). seed: the sub-seed for this system's streams.
fallsNote: Waterfalls near the camera (src/world/falls-near.js): the lips the falls pass reads back (water.json falls soundReadS) are joined into falls, lips within joinM of each other across and topM in height being one fall; then, with the near sample, the falls within reachM of the camera target carrying at least minFlowM3s, nearest first, at most voices of them, go to the sound (ambience.json falls).
pondNote: The pond tier's small sounds (src/audio/creatures-game.js; doc 25 'Creature voices'): the live schools (src/world/creatures/schools.js) of the species in sips are heard sipping at the surface each time one rises and rings it (their recipe's voice block, model surface-sip), read with the frogs every frogs.pollS seconds, started leadS ahead on the audio clock and let go if older than staleS; the species in wings are heard by their wings (model wing-rattle), each one at its own place, updated with the ambience.
